name: Feudal Lord
description: Owns the land, owns the people on it, that's just how it works
behavioral_signature: Treats authority as property and loyalty as rent
under_stress: Demands tribute and obedience as proof of control
at_rest: Generous to vassals, ruthless to outsiders
will_always: protect their domain and the people who serve it
unless: a greater lord they actually respect makes a demand
